verdict.rationale: Meltano is pip-installable and Docker-packaged, explicitly documented as something you can 'host and manage on your own servers,' and a runtime probe confirms `meltano init` works locally and keylessly to lay out a full project; community evidence corroborates real production self-hosted use (GitLab Data Team). Missing for 10: independent third-party audit or dedicated production self-hosting/hardening guide beyond anecdotal community reports.
